**Abstract.** In this note we prove an explicit binomial formula for Jack poly nomials and discuss some applications of it. 1. Jack polynomials ( [M,St]). The operators {D(u;θ),u ∈ C} generate a commutative algebra; denote it by D(n;θ). We normalize Pλ (x1,...,x n;θ) so that Pλ (x1,...,x n;θ) = xλ 1 1 ...x λ n n +... , where dots stand for lower monomials in lexicographic order . Then one has (1.2) P(λ 1+1,...,λ n+1)(x;θ) = ( ∏ xi ) Pλ (x;θ).
